# generated observation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:generatedObservation`](gmeow-generatedObservation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/generatedObservation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

Relates an observational activity to an observation it generated as a first-class output. The inverse direction ([`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) → [`Activity`](../classes/gmeow-Activity.md)) is covered by the general [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md) (provenance module), since [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) ⊑ [`Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) and [`ObservationalActivity`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationalActivity.md) ⊑ [`Activity`](../classes/gmeow-Activity.md). This property is deliberately NOT asserted as [owl:inverseOf](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#inverseOf) [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md), because that would force every [`Activity`](../classes/gmeow-Activity.md) that generates anything to be an [`ObservationalActivity`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationalActivity.md) (OWL 2 DL typing interaction).
